                          Exes Being Dragged to Court Over Old Legal
body:
Katy Perry and Orlando Bloom
                          Exes Being Dragged to Court Over Old Legal Battle
                      
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Katy Perry and her ex, Orlando Bloom, could be pulled back into an old legal fight by the man who sued over a real estate deal gone south involving the pop star ... TMZ has learned.
      
    
            According to court docs, obtained by TMZ, the exes are being dragged back into the legal battle brought by businessman Carl Westcott.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            As you may recall, Carl sued Katy’s business manager, Bernie Gudvi, to undo the sale of a $15 million home in Santa Barbara. He lost the case and was ordered to hand over the keys to Katy, but she was ordered to pay the remaining balance on the home purchase … which came out to around $4 million.
      

            In his new docs, Carl said Katy wired him $900K in June but did not send the remaining balance. Carl asked for permission to subpoena Katy and Orlando, which would allow him to grill the two about the money he says he's still owed.
      
    
      
        
              
    
    
            Katy’s manager fired back at the request, claiming there was no emergency. He said the money owed cannot be paid to Carl until Carl’s appeal over a separate $3 million he allegedly owes to Bernie is resolved.
      
    
            Bernie said Carl is clearly trying to harass Katy and Orlando with his request for subpoenas. The judge has yet to rule.
      
    
            Katy and Orlando began dating in 2016 and split in 2025. They share a 6-year-old daughter, Daisy.

description:
Billy Joel
                          'My Neurologist Says I'm Not Allowed to Perform or Drive'
body:
Billy Joel
                          'My Neurologist Says I'm Not Allowed to Perform or Drive'
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              October 15, 2026
                            7:03 PM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Music icon Billy Joel is giving a rare update on his health and he sadly says he may never perform again. 
      
    
            In an interview with The Hollywood Reporter the “Just The Way You Are” singer said when it comes to his future as a performer … “I don’t know. I have to take a series of tests before I know, but … I’m not allowed to drive. And I can’t do performances because what the neurologist told me, every time you do a show, it’s like you’re getting a concussion.”
      
    
            As we told you, Billy is currently auctioning off over 70 of his motorcycles and told The Hollywood Reporter “I have a condition called hydrocephalus, which makes driving a little bit iffy. So I realized it’s time for me to turn it over to somebody else.”
      
    
            Proceeds from the sale of Billy's bikes will go toward his organization, The Joel Foundation.
      

            Despite his positive attitude towards his diagnosis, Billy hasn’t had the best of luck recently. Just last month, Joel lost his best friend and former bandmate Jon Small and gave a moving tribute to Small on his Instagram, saying “Losing Jon has hit me in a way I have never experienced. It is difficult to imagine this world without him in it.” 
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            The good news is Joel said his memory and balance improved after his surgery, and continued ... “I’m not going anywhere, I’m here. I’m still here.”
